depiction.primary_object: clock face with two hands inside a circular arrow

readings.meaning: reschedule, postpone, snooze, or move forward in time
recurring schedule, routine, or periodic update
time history, activity log, or backup restore

ambiguity: Closely resembles the standard counter-clockwise 'history/restore' icon, and at small sizes the arrow direction is barely distinguishable from a plain clock or a reverse-time icon.

modifier_semantics.meaning: advancing time, repeating on a cycle, or updating/refreshing a schedule

extend a deadline or renewal timer

reasoning: Shows clock hands inside a clockwise circular arrow, representing rescheduling, advancing time, recurring schedules, or time logs/history. It fits tasks explicitly about shifting schedules, automated intervals, or time tracking, though it is easily confused with a plain clock or the counter-clockwise history/restore icon and should not be used merely because a task has a due time.
